query: I am planning a 14 day solo wildlife trip to India focusing on ranthmbore and Bandhavgarh. I am very interested in photographing tigers and understanding forest ecosystems. I would like guided safaris with experienced naturalists. Clean eco lodges near the forest are important. Safe transport between parks is required. I am also interested in birdwatching opportunities during the trip.
